references.text: Repeats the age limit of twenty years and upward for counting the congregation of Israel
The second census uses the same age requirement: from twenty years and upward, all who can go out to war
Establishes twenty years as the age to be counted among those mustered in Israel
Refers to all who were mustered from twenty years and upward
Those who were mustered from twenty years and upward were to die in the wilderness because of their grumbling
David did not count those under twenty years in his census
The Levites from twenty years and upward were mustered for service
Summarizes the result of counting all men fit for war from twenty years and upward
Confirms that the census applied to Israel's army, and that the Levites were not counted with them
